Per the verifier resolution rules ('unverifiable -> downgrade to Not known; never keep a value you could not confirm'), every sourced value has been downgraded. Additionally, the session web-search budget was exhausted (200/200) before the mandatory independent searches for the 'Not known' fields (3.1.2, 3.1.3, 3.1.4, 3.1.6, 3.2.1) could run, so no upgrades were possible either. open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the full legal name, legal form, and state/country of incorporation of the Mux contracting entity (Mux, Inc.), and its current registered address (50 Beale St 9th Floor vs 88 Stevenson Street, San Francisco).
Have you appointed a representative in the EU under Article 27 GDPR? If yes, please provide the representative's name and full address (and the UK equivalent, if any).

Is a Data Protection Officer formally designated under Article 37 GDPR? Please confirm the DPO's name, telephone number, and email address (your DPA names Cyril Duprat / dpo@mux.com — please confirm this is current and that this is a formal DPO designation).
What minimum TLS version do you enforce for data in transit (API, video ingest, and delivery endpoints)?
What encryption standard/algorithm is used for encryption at rest of stored customer video content and associated metadata (e.g. AES-256)?
Are backups of customer content encrypted, and with which algorithm?
Who generates and manages the encryption keys for data at rest — Mux (customer-specific or shared keys?) or can customers supply/manage their own keys (BYOK/CMEK)?

Can personal data (including uploaded video content) be anonymized and/or pseudonymized by Mux on customer request, beyond the documented Mux Data IP-address truncation? In particular, does any pseudonymization capability apply to video assets and their metadata (the data Tavus sends), as opposed to Mux Data viewer telemetry?
Do you hold a current SOC 2 Type II report in addition to your ISO 27001 certification? Please share the report (e.g. via trust.mux.com) so it can be placed on file.
Do you offer an EU region or EU data residency option for Mux Video storage/processing, i.e. can customer video content be kept within the EU?
